h1: Custom Two Tone Koozies for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Two Tone Koozies | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom two tone koozies for your next event. Perfect for branding with your logo. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Two tone koozies offer a simple way to add visual interest to your branded drinkware without extra cost. The contrasting color bands create a classic look that stands out at tailgates, trade shows, and company picnics. Choose from a wide range of color combinations to match your logo or event theme. The collapsible design makes them easy to store and hand out, while the neoprene construction keeps drinks cold longer. Perfect for bulk orders with screen printing or full-color decoration.
heroAltText: Custom two tone koozies with contrasting color bands and logo imprint, displayed on a table at an outdoor event.
